candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment that updates acc.unlockTime with one that always sets it to the provided _unlockTime (removing the max with block.timestamp), allowing unlockTime in the past or future as given.
Replace the assignment updating acc.unlockTime to always set it to current block.timestamp (ignoring the provided _unlockTime), so unlockTime becomes now on each Put.
Replace the require check with one that also demands msg.value > 0, preventing zero-value calls from changing state.
Replace the order of updates: set unlockTime before increasing acc.balance, which can affect observable state if LogFile or reentrancy uses balance during logging.
Replace the LogFile.AddMessage call with a no-op (removed), so no log message is emitted after Put.
